stopConditions: BUSINESS_DECISION_MISSING: no answer in decision register and story cannot proceed without it

package.description: The complete manual journal vertical: balanced posting API (single point of ledger truth), draft workspace, on-demand validation sharing one rule source with posting, direct-post, JE view with reversal linkage, posted-JE reversal, and draft void. Built in coa-service on the R0-ACCOUNTING-SETUP foundation (accounts, periods, sources, sequences all in-process, one DB, one SERIALIZABLE transaction). Inquiry, Trial Balance, financial statements and reporting are NOT in this package.
package.completionGate: All stories DONE or DONE_PENDING_INTEGRATION; full vertical Draft->validate->post->view->reverse->void demonstrated against real dev Postgres + api-gateway
package.integrationGate: All DONE_PENDING_INTEGRATION stories re-tested green against real S007/S207 services + broker-backed acct.je.posted verification
package.scopeGuard: Do NOT start inquiry, Trial Balance, financial statements or reporting stories in this package.
package.architectureDecision: ADR-JL-001: journal lifecycle lives in coa-service (not the legacy gl-service prototype). Rationale: all posting dependencies (S209 period eligibility, S212 source class, S210 account active+postable+type, S213 numbering, S208 date->period) are in-process in coa-service on the shared amacc DB, enabling a single atomic SERIALIZABLE posting transaction and one rule engine shared by validate (S215) and post (S013/S216) — the packet's explicit anti-divergence requirement. The gl-service DR=CR trigger + NUMERIC(15,2) + SERIALIZABLE-retry + outbox patterns are ADOPTED (Reuse After Refactoring); the AI review gate and 30s auto-approve are stripped per packet §7.

S205.title: User Account Lifecycle
S205.layman: Create logins for staff and switch them off the day they leave, so only current employees can touch the books.
specDeviations: User routes co-located in auth-service under /api/v1/iam/users (alongside S206 roles / S207 authz) so the deny-by-default guard calls the real AuthzPort in-process; no gateway change needed (the /api/v1/iam prefix already routes to auth-service).

No login/token endpoint in this story — the prototype unvalidated token issuance is discarded per packet §7. The 'authenticate but sees nothing until a role is assigned' AC is proven via the deny-by-default authz check for a role-less user (NO_MATCHING_ROLE). Credential auth / session issuance is a follow-up.
Lockout is driven by recordFailedLogin (unit-tested at threshold 5); with no login endpoint yet, the runtime transcript demonstrates the unlock path against a LOCKED user.

stabilizationReconciliation.correctedBecause: This story's own specDeviations already admit 'No login/token endpoint in this story — the prototype unvalidated token issuance is discarded... Credential auth / session issuance is a follow-up.' A user-lifecycle story with no way for a created user to actually authenticate is a materially incomplete acceptance criterion, not merely an integration-pending gap. DONE_PENDING_INTEGRATION is reserved for stories whose functional scope is complete and only cross-cutting wiring (authz/audit/broker/tenancy proof) remains.

finalR0Certification.correctedBecause: A real login/session-issuance endpoint now exists and was proven live through the real API gateway against real PostgreSQL: bcrypt-verified credentials, jsonwebtoken-signed JWT + persisted Session row, session validation (whoami), authorized tenant-scoped access, and correct denial of wrong password / absent token / invalid token / expired token / revoked session / cross-tenant access. The previously-admitted gap ("no login/token endpoint") is closed.
finalR0Certification.auditGapClosure: Every DENIED login attempt now produces a categorized audit event (USER_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_PASSWORD, TENANT_MISMATCH, ACCOUNT_DISABLED, ACCOUNT_LOCKED) with tenant context, attempted email, correlationId, ipAddress and outcome=DENIED, and never contains password, password hash, JWT, or session token. Verified end-to-end in audit_outbox and the drained central audit_logs table under per-tenant RLS visibility.
defectsFixedThisPhase: NODE_ENV=development authentication bypass (Priority 0) — replaced with explicit AUTH_BYPASS_ENABLED opt-in.
Postgres runtime role was a BYPASSRLS superuser, making all RLS policies inert — introduced restricted amacc_app role.
RlsTenantContext was never set on the pre-authentication /login and /logout routes, causing every login to silently see zero rows.
grantAssignment()/_assertEntityInTenant() unconditionally rejected entityId=null, contradicting documented tenant-wide-admin semantics.

shared-kernel verifyJWT/createServiceToken computed HMAC signatures via digest('binary') fed into a UTF-8 Buffer.from(), corrupting every real JWT signature for bytes >= 0x80 — broke all cross-service authorization until fixed to digest('base64url').

HttpAuditClient sent no Authorization header to the audit-service /log route, causing the audit-outbox drainer to fail closed (401) once the dev bypass was closed — fixed by signing an internal service JWT.
Failed-login attempts produced no audit trail at all — closed via _recordLoginDenied() covering 5 categorized reasons.
